gloss.en: the range of things that a subject, job or activity covers (from Greek skopos: a target to look at)

sentences.en: That question is outside the [scope] of this course.
sentences.tr: O soru bu dersin kapsamı dışında.
sentences.de: Diese Frage liegt außerhalb des Rahmens dieses Kurses.
sentences.fr: Cette question dépasse le cadre de ce cours.
sentences.it: Questa domanda esula dall'ambito di questo corso.
sentences.es: Esa pregunta está fuera del alcance de este curso.

sentences.en: There is plenty of [scope] for improvement.
sentences.tr: Gelişmeye fazlasıyla alan var.
sentences.de: Es gibt viel Raum für Verbesserungen.
sentences.fr: Il y a beaucoup de marge de progression.
sentences.it: C'è molto margine di miglioramento.
sentences.es: Hay mucho margen de mejora.

gloss.en: a tube with lenses that makes faraway things look closer (literally: far-looker)

sentences.en: Through the [telescope] we could see Saturn's rings.
sentences.tr: Teleskopla Satürn'ün halkalarını görebildik.
sentences.de: Durch das Teleskop konnten wir die Ringe des Saturn sehen.
sentences.fr: Au télescope, nous avons pu voir les anneaux de Saturne.
sentences.it: Con il telescopio abbiamo visto gli anelli di Saturno.
sentences.es: Con el telescopio pudimos ver los anillos de Saturno.

sentences.en: Galileo pointed his [telescope] at the moon.
sentences.tr: Galileo teleskobunu aya çevirdi.
sentences.de: Galilei richtete sein Fernrohr auf den Mond.
sentences.fr: Galilée a pointé son télescope vers la lune.
sentences.it: Galileo puntò il suo telescopio verso la luna.
sentences.es: Galileo apuntó su telescopio a la luna.

gloss.en: able to slide into itself to get shorter, like a telescope; using a telescope

sentences.en: I bought a [telescopic] pole to clean the windows.
sentences.tr: Camları silmek için teleskopik bir sap aldım.
sentences.de: Ich habe eine ausziehbare Stange zum Fensterputzen gekauft.
sentences.fr: J'ai acheté une perche télescopique pour laver les vitres.
sentences.it: Ho comprato un'asta telescopica per pulire le finestre.
sentences.es: Compré un palo telescópico para limpiar las ventanas.

sentences.en: The hunter's rifle had a [telescopic] sight.
sentences.tr: Avcının tüfeğinde dürbünlü bir nişangâh vardı.
sentences.de: Das Gewehr des Jägers hatte ein Zielfernrohr.
sentences.fr: Le fusil du chasseur avait une lunette de visée.
sentences.it: Il fucile del cacciatore aveva un mirino telescopico.
sentences.es: El rifle del cazador tenía una mira telescópica.

gloss.en: an instrument that makes very small things look big (literally: small-looker)

sentences.en: Under the [microscope], the drop of water was full of life.
sentences.tr: Mikroskop altında su damlası canlılarla doluydu.
sentences.de: Unter dem Mikroskop war der Wassertropfen voller Leben.
sentences.fr: Au microscope, la goutte d'eau grouillait de vie.
sentences.it: Al microscopio, la goccia d'acqua era piena di vita.
sentences.es: Bajo el microscopio, la gota de agua estaba llena de vida.

sentences.en: Every student in the lab has a [microscope].
sentences.tr: Laboratuvardaki her öğrencinin bir mikroskobu var.
sentences.de: Jeder Schüler im Labor hat ein Mikroskop.
sentences.fr: Chaque élève du labo a un microscope.
sentences.it: Ogni studente del laboratorio ha un microscopio.
sentences.es: Cada alumno del laboratorio tiene un microscopio.

gloss.en: so small that you need a microscope to see it; very small

sentences.en: Bacteria are [microscopic] living things.
sentences.tr: Bakteriler mikroskobik canlılardır.
sentences.de: Bakterien sind mikroskopisch kleine Lebewesen.
sentences.fr: Les bactéries sont des êtres vivants microscopiques.
sentences.it: I batteri sono esseri viventi microscopici.
sentences.es: Las bacterias son seres vivos microscópicos.

sentences.en: The kitchen in our flat is [microscopic]!
sentences.tr: Dairemizdeki mutfak minicik!
sentences.de: Die Küche in unserer Wohnung ist winzig!
sentences.fr: La cuisine de notre appart est microscopique !
sentences.it: La cucina del nostro appartamento è microscopica!
sentences.es: ¡La cocina de nuestro piso es microscópica!

gloss.en: so small that only a microscope shows it; with a microscope

sentences.en: The two coins differ only [microscopically].
sentences.tr: İki madeni para yalnızca mikroskobik düzeyde farklı.
sentences.de: Die beiden Münzen unterscheiden sich nur mikroskopisch.
sentences.fr: Les deux pièces ne diffèrent que microscopiquement.
sentences.it: Le due monete differiscono solo microscopicamente.
sentences.es: Las dos monedas solo se diferencian microscópicamente.

sentences.en: Every sample was checked [microscopically].
sentences.tr: Her örnek mikroskopla kontrol edildi.
sentences.de: Jede Probe wurde mikroskopisch geprüft.
sentences.fr: Chaque échantillon a été examiné au microscope.
sentences.it: Ogni campione è stato controllato al microscopio.
sentences.es: Cada muestra se examinó al microscopio.

gloss.en: the use of microscopes to study very small things

sentences.en: [Microscopy] showed tiny cracks in the metal.
sentences.tr: Mikroskopi metalde çok küçük çatlaklar olduğunu gösterdi.
sentences.de: Die Mikroskopie zeigte winzige Risse im Metall.
sentences.fr: La microscopie a révélé de minuscules fissures dans le métal.
sentences.it: La microscopia ha mostrato piccolissime crepe nel metallo.
sentences.es: La microscopía mostró grietas diminutas en el metal.

sentences.en: She took a course in [microscopy] last summer.
sentences.tr: Geçen yaz mikroskopi kursu aldı.
sentences.de: Sie hat letzten Sommer einen Mikroskopie-Kurs gemacht.
sentences.fr: Elle a suivi un cours de microscopie l'été dernier.
sentences.it: L'estate scorsa ha seguito un corso di microscopia.
sentences.es: El verano pasado hizo un curso de microscopía.

gloss.en: a long tube with mirrors that lets you see over or around things, used in submarines (literally: look around)

sentences.en: The captain raised the [periscope] to look for ships.
sentences.tr: Kaptan gemileri görmek için periskobu kaldırdı.
sentences.de: Der Kapitän fuhr das Periskop aus, um nach Schiffen zu suchen.
sentences.fr: Le capitaine a sorti le périscope pour chercher des navires.
sentences.it: Il capitano alzò il periscopio per cercare le navi.
sentences.es: El capitán subió el periscopio para buscar barcos.

sentences.en: The kids made a [periscope] from a box and two mirrors.
sentences.tr: Çocuklar bir kutu ve iki aynadan periskop yaptı.
sentences.de: Die Kinder bauten ein Periskop aus einer Schachtel und zwei Spiegeln.
sentences.fr: Les enfants ont fabriqué un périscope avec une boîte et deux miroirs.
sentences.it: I bambini hanno costruito un periscopio con una scatola e due specchi.
sentences.es: Los niños hicieron un periscopio con una caja y dos espejos.

gloss.en: a forecast of a person's future based on the stars at their birth (literally: hour-watcher)

sentences.en: My mother reads her [horoscope] every morning.
sentences.tr: Annem her sabah burç yorumunu okur.
sentences.de: Meine Mutter liest jeden Morgen ihr Horoskop.
sentences.fr: Ma mère lit son horoscope tous les matins.
sentences.it: Mia madre legge l'oroscopo ogni mattina.
sentences.es: Mi madre lee su horóscopo cada mañana.

sentences.en: My [horoscope] said I would meet someone special today.
sentences.tr: Burç yorumum bugün özel biriyle tanışacağımı söyledi.
sentences.de: Mein Horoskop sagte, ich würde heute jemand Besonderen treffen.
sentences.fr: Mon horoscope disait que je rencontrerais quelqu'un de spécial aujourd'hui.
sentences.it: Il mio oroscopo diceva che oggi avrei incontrato qualcuno di speciale.
sentences.es: Mi horóscopo decía que hoy conocería a alguien especial.

gloss.en: a tool a doctor uses to listen to your heart and lungs (literally: chest examiner)

sentences.en: The doctor listened to my chest with a [stethoscope].
sentences.tr: Doktor steteskopla göğsümü dinledi.
sentences.de: Die Ärztin hörte meine Brust mit dem Stethoskop ab.
sentences.fr: Le médecin a écouté ma poitrine avec un stéthoscope.
sentences.it: Il medico mi ha auscultato il petto con lo stetoscopio.
sentences.es: El médico me auscultó el pecho con el estetoscopio.

sentences.en: The [stethoscope] felt cold on my back.
sentences.tr: Steteskop sırtımda soğuk geldi.
sentences.de: Das Stethoskop fühlte sich kalt auf meinem Rücken an.
sentences.fr: Le stéthoscope était froid sur mon dos.
sentences.it: Lo stetoscopio era freddo sulla mia schiena.
sentences.es: El estetoscopio estaba frío en mi espalda.

gloss.en: a toy tube with mirrors and colored pieces that make changing patterns; a changing mix of many things (literally: viewer of beautiful forms)

sentences.en: Turn the [kaleidoscope] slowly to see new patterns.
sentences.tr: Yeni desenler görmek için çiçek dürbününü yavaşça çevir.
sentences.de: Dreh das Kaleidoskop langsam, um neue Muster zu sehen.
sentences.fr: Tourne doucement le kaléidoscope pour voir de nouveaux motifs.
sentences.it: Gira piano il caleidoscopio per vedere nuove figure.
sentences.es: Gira despacio el caleidoscopio para ver nuevos dibujos.

sentences.en: The market was a [kaleidoscope] of colors and smells.
sentences.tr: Pazar, renk ve kokulardan oluşan bir kaleydoskoptu.
sentences.de: Der Markt war ein Kaleidoskop aus Farben und Gerüchen.
sentences.fr: Le marché était un kaléidoscope de couleurs et d'odeurs.
sentences.it: Il mercato era un caleidoscopio di colori e odori.
sentences.es: El mercado era un caleidoscopio de colores y olores.

gloss.en: a spinning wheel that keeps its direction, used to keep ships, planes and phones steady (literally: circle-watcher)

sentences.en: A [gyroscope] in your phone knows which way it is turned.
sentences.tr: Telefonundaki jiroskop, telefonun hangi yöne döndüğünü algılar.
sentences.de: Ein Gyroskop im Handy merkt, wie es gedreht wird.
sentences.fr: Un gyroscope dans ton téléphone sait dans quel sens il est tourné.
sentences.it: Un giroscopio nel telefono capisce come è girato.
sentences.es: Un giroscopio en tu móvil sabe hacia dónde está girado.

sentences.en: The spinning [gyroscope] stayed upright on the string.
sentences.tr: Dönen jiroskop ipin üzerinde dik durdu.
sentences.de: Der sich drehende Kreisel blieb auf der Schnur aufrecht.
sentences.fr: Le gyroscope en rotation restait droit sur la ficelle.
sentences.it: Il giroscopio in rotazione restava dritto sul filo.
sentences.es: El giroscopio, al girar, se mantenía en pie sobre la cuerda.

gloss.en: a medical test in which a doctor looks inside the body with a thin camera tube (literally: looking inside)

sentences.en: The doctor ordered an [endoscopy] to check my stomach.
sentences.tr: Doktor midemi kontrol etmek için endoskopi istedi.
sentences.de: Der Arzt ordnete eine Magenspiegelung an.
sentences.fr: Le médecin a prescrit une endoscopie pour examiner mon estomac.
sentences.it: Il medico ha prescritto un'endoscopia per controllare lo stomaco.
sentences.es: El médico pidió una endoscopia para revisarme el estómago.

sentences.en: You can't eat anything before an [endoscopy].
sentences.tr: Endoskopiden önce hiçbir şey yiyemezsin.
sentences.de: Vor einer Endoskopie darf man nichts essen.
sentences.fr: On ne peut rien manger avant une endoscopie.
sentences.it: Prima di un'endoscopia non si può mangiare niente.
sentences.es: No puedes comer nada antes de una endoscopia.

gloss.en: a thin tube with a camera that doctors use to look inside the body

sentences.en: The doctor used an [endoscope] to look at his stomach.
sentences.tr: Doktor midesine bakmak için endoskop kullandı.
sentences.de: Die Ärztin untersuchte seinen Magen mit einem Endoskop.
sentences.fr: Le médecin a utilisé un endoscope pour examiner son estomac.
sentences.it: Il medico ha usato un endoscopio per guardargli lo stomaco.
sentences.es: La médica usó un endoscopio para ver su estómago.

sentences.en: The [endoscope] has a light at the end.
sentences.tr: Endoskobun ucunda bir ışık var.
sentences.de: Das Endoskop hat vorne eine Lampe.
sentences.fr: L'endoscope a une lumière au bout.
sentences.it: L'endoscopio ha una luce in punta.
sentences.es: El endoscopio tiene una luz en la punta.
